```{r}
leverkusen15_16 <- read_csv("~/Desktop/bayer15_16.csv")
leverkusen15_16
```

```{r}

leverkusen15_16["Win"] <- leverkusen15_16["Was it a win?"]
leverkusen15_16

logt_model <- glm(
  Win ~ Centralisation,
  data = leverkusen15_16,
  family = binomial
)

summary(logt_model)
```

```{r}
t.test(Centralisation ~ Win, data = leverkusen15_16)
```

```{r}
leverkusen15_16["Home"] <- leverkusen15_16["Was it played at home?"]
logt_model2 <- glm(
  Home ~ Centralisation,
  data = leverkusen15_16,
  family = binomial
)

summary(logt_model2)
```

```{r}
model <- glm(
  Win ~ Centralisation + factor(Home),
  data = leverkusen15_16,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

summary(model)
```
